title: Alien Breed Tower Assault original supplied SPS279 IPF release

build.scope: Fresh native root compiled using five unchanged root sources and eleven retained Overdrive-corrected component DLLs, frozen compiler/SDK and graphics composer. Manifest generated from current verified inputs rather than inherited historical tables. Bounded PAL OCS 68000, 512 KiB Chip plus 512 KiB A501. No complete moving-main ROM or standard-app admission claim.
build.sourceLineage: Overdrive 84525a2 (Chip priority -10, A501 priority 0), Alien Breed a897cc3 / db8b8a1; includes F17, Lemmings and caller-owned trap-zero compatibility, graphics installer FF8000.
build.manifestScope: Generated directly from the current verified build-inputs.json and actual output, without inherited inputs or graphics-entry tables. This supersedes the former qualification driver metadata, with the same guest root and native compilation flags.
